background.en: Reading proficiency in early education is a critical challenge in multilingual nations like the Philippines, where students often struggle with comprehension and decoding. Existing digital literacy tools are predominantly English-centric, lack interactive features, and frequently require internet connectivity, making them impractical for remote or underserved schools.
background.id: Kemampuan membaca pada pendidikan anak usia dini merupakan tantangan kritis di negara-negara multilinguistik seperti Filipina, di mana siswa sering kali mengalami kesulitan dalam pemahaman dan *decoding*. Alat literasi digital yang ada sebagian besar berpusat pada bahasa Inggris, kurang memiliki fitur interaktif, dan sering kali memerlukan koneksi internet, sehingga tidak praktis untuk sekolah di daerah terpencil atau kurang terlayani.

contributions.en: The study introduces iRead, a mobile application designed to support early literacy in three languages with full offline functionality. Its primary novelty lies in developing a novel small-vocabulary acoustic model for Hiligaynon trained from scratch using child speech data, integrated alongside pretrained models for English and Filipino within a grammar-constrained decoding framework.
contributions.id: Studi ini memperkenalkan iRead, sebuah aplikasi seluler yang dirancang untuk mendukung literasi dini dalam tiga bahasa dengan fungsionalitas *offline* penuh. Kebaruan utamanya terletak pada pengembangan *acoustic model* *small-vocabulary* yang baru untuk bahasa Hiligaynon yang dilatih dari awal menggunakan data ucapan anak, yang diintegrasikan bersama *pretrained model* untuk bahasa Inggris dan Filipina dalam kerangka kerja *grammar-constrained* *decoding*.

future_work.en: The authors note limitations including a small training dataset for Hiligaynon from only four speakers, a focus on isolated single-word phonics tasks rather than continuous speech, and a lack of longitudinal educational outcome assessments. Future work includes expanding training data for better accent and age-group generalization, supporting longer speech inputs such as sentences and paragraphs, and conducting real-world classroom evaluations.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat keterbatasan termasuk *dataset* pelatihan yang kecil untuk bahasa Hiligaynon dari hanya empat penutur, fokus pada tugas fonik kata tunggal terisolasi daripada ucapan kontinu, dan kurangnya penilaian hasil pendidikan longitudinal. Pekerjaan di masa mendatang mencakup memperluas data pelatihan untuk generalisasi aksen dan kelompok usia yang lebih baik, mendukung masukan ucapan yang lebih panjang seperti kalimat dan paragraf, serta melakukan evaluasi kelas di dunia nyata.

method.en: The iRead application was developed for Android using the Flutter framework, utilizing the Vosk API with Kaldi-based acoustic models for offline speech recognition. For Hiligaynon, a small-vocabulary dataset of 380 phonics-based words was collected from four child speakers, and a GMM-HMM pipeline was employed for training using Leave-One-Speaker-Out cross-validation. The system evaluation utilized 540 total utterances across English, Filipino, and Hiligaynon under controlled conditions.
method.id: Aplikasi iRead dikembangkan untuk Android menggunakan *framework* Flutter, dengan memanfaatkan API Vosk dan *acoustic model* berbasis Kaldi untuk *offline speech recognition*. Untuk bahasa Hiligaynon, *dataset* *small-vocabulary* yang terdiri dari 380 kata berbasis fonik dikumpulkan dari empat penutur anak, dan *pipeline* *GMM-HMM* digunakan untuk pelatihan dengan validasi silang *Leave-One-Speaker-Out*. Evaluasi sistem menggunakan total 540 ujaran di bahasa Inggris, Filipina, dan Hiligaynon di bawah kondisi terkontrol.

related_work.en: Prior mobile reading applications developed in the Philippines mostly focused on English or limited combinations of English and Filipino, with minimal support for regional languages such as Hiligaynon and Bisaya. Furthermore, these existing tools generally lacked offline capabilities, culturally relevant content, and integrated speech recognition for local languages.
related_work.id: Aplikasi membaca seluler sebelumnya yang dikembangkan di Filipina sebagian besar berfokus pada bahasa Inggris atau kombinasi terbatas antara bahasa Inggris dan Filipina, dengan dukungan minimal untuk bahasa regional seperti Hiligaynon dan Bisaya. Selain itu, alat-alat yang ada ini umumnya tidak memiliki kemampuan *offline*, konten yang relevan secara budaya, dan pengenalan suara terintegrasi untuk bahasa lokal.

results.en: Evaluation results showed average recognition accuracies of 92.8 percent for English, 88.3 percent for Filipino, and 85.6 percent for Hiligaynon, with Leave-One-Speaker-Out validation showing high consistency for Hiligaynon. Category-level analysis revealed that vowels achieved the highest accuracy, followed by consonants and consonant-vowel blends, demonstrating that a classical GMM-HMM approach combined with grammar-constrained decoding is viable for low-resource mobile literacy applications.
results.id: Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan akurasi pengenalan rata-rata sebesar 92,8 persen untuk bahasa Inggris, 88.3 persen untuk bahasa Filipina, dan 85.6 persen untuk bahasa Hiligaynon, dengan validasi *Leave-One-Speaker-Out* yang menunjukkan konsistensi tinggi untuk Hiligaynon. Analisis tingkat kategori mengungkapkan bahwa vokal mencapai akurasi tertinggi, diikuti oleh konsonan dan *consonant-vowel blends*, yang menunjukkan bahwa pendekatan *GMM-HMM* klasik yang dikombinasikan dengan *grammar-constrained* *decoding* layak untuk aplikasi literasi seluler *low-resource*.

tldr.en: This paper presents iRead, a multilingual mobile reading application featuring integrated offline speech recognition for English, Filipino, and Hiligaynon. Evaluations demonstrate that the small-vocabulary system achieves high recognition accuracies across all three languages.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan iRead, sebuah aplikasi membaca seluler multilinguistik yang dilengkapi *offline speech recognition* terintegrasi untuk bahasa Inggris, Filipina, dan Hiligaynon. Evaluasi menunjukkan bahwa sistem *small-vocabulary* ini mencapai akurasi pengenalan yang tinggi di ketiga bahasa.

doi:10.14445/22315381/ijett-v74i7p110.title: iRead: A Reading Enhancement Platform with Integrated Small-Vocabulary Speech Recognition for English, Filipino, and Hiligaynon
doi:10.14445/22315381/ijett-v74i7p110.venue: International Journal of Engineering Trends and Technology

doi:10.14445/22315381/ijett-v74i8p116.abstract: Evaluating linguistically diverse descriptive answers in a consistent and accurate manner in modern digital education systems is a growing challenge, especially in low-resource languages like Hindi. Traditional lexical and rule-based grading systems cannot adequately reflect the meaning behind the words, negation, paraphrasing, and so on, which leads to low grading reliability. To overcome these limitations, this study proposes an automated evaluation framework with intelligent rule-based linguistic preprocessing and transformer-based deep learning. The framework uses a fine-tuned multilingual BERT (mBERT) model bhavikardeshna/multilingual-bert-base-cased-hindi to provide contextual embeddings, and cosine similarity-based semantic alignment with the model l3cube-pune/hindi-sentence-similarity-sbert is used to provide automated scores. With optimal setting of learning rate = 5×10⁻⁴, batch size = 24 and epochs = 40, accuracy, precision, recall and F1 score of 78.9%, 80.6%, 77.4% and 79.0% respectively is achieved on HindiRC-Data-master dataset (24 passages, 127 question-answer pairs, grades 2-5) which is more than 14% higher than lexical similarity baselines and is better than previous Hindi QA architectures without domain-specific preprocessing pipelines. The suggested system will save about 40% manual grading, and will enable scalable, consistent and repeatable assessment.

glossary.explanation_id: Arsitektur *deep learning* yang sepenuhnya mengandalkan mekanisme *attention* untuk memproses data sekuensial secara paralel.
Model bahasa BERT multibahasa yang dilatih pada korpus dari banyak bahasa termasuk bahasa Indonesia dan Hindi.
Modifikasi dari arsitektur BERT yang menggunakan *siamese network* untuk menghasilkan *embedding* kalimat yang efisien untuk tugas penghitungan kemiripan.
Proses memecah teks masukan menjadi unit-unit kecil yang disebut *token* seperti kata atau subkata sebelum diproses oleh model.
Proses pengubahan bentuk infleksi suatu kata kembali ke bentuk dasar atau kamusnya yang disebut *lemma*.
Metrik matematis untuk mengukur tingkat kesamaan antara dua vektor dalam ruang multidimensi berdasarkan sudut di antara keduanya.
Proses pencarian pengaturan parameter pelatihan terbaik seperti *learning rate* dan *batch size* untuk mengoptimalkan performa model.
Proses melatih ulang model bahasa yang sudah dilatih sebelumnya pada *dataset* spesifik domain tertentu.

background.en:
Evaluating linguistically diverse descriptive answers consistently and accurately in modern digital education systems is a growing challenge, especially in low-resource languages like Hindi. Traditional lexical and rule-based grading systems fail to capture underlying meanings, negations, and paraphrasing, resulting in low grading reliability. Furthermore, manual grading is time-consuming, highly subjective, and prone to significant inter-rater variability across large volumes of student assessments.

This paper addresses the gap by providing a fully automated evaluation pipeline tailored for Hindi descriptive answers in primary education. Hindi poses specific difficulties due to its rich morphology, complex negation patterns, and limited NLP tooling compared to well-resourced languages. The proposed system aims to replace subjective human grading with scalable, consistent, and repeatable automated assessments.
background.id:
Evaluasi jawaban deskriptif yang beragam secara linguistik secara konsisten dan akurat dalam sistem pendidikan digital modern menjadi tantangan yang semakin besar, terutama pada bahasa *low-resource* seperti Hindi. Sistem penilain leksikal dan berbasis aturan tradisional gagal menangkap makna mendalam, negasi, dan parafrase, yang berakibat pada rendahnya keandalan penilaian. Selain itu, penilaian manual memerlukan waktu yang lama, sangat subjektif, dan rentan terhadap variabilitas antarpenilai yang signifikan pada volume penilaian siswa yang besar.

Makalah ini mengatasi kesenjangan tersebut dengan menyediakan *pipeline* evaluasi yang sepenuhnya otomatis yang disesuaikan untuk jawaban deskriptif bahasa Hindi pada pendidikan dasar. Bahasa Hindi menghadirkan kesulitan khusus karena morfologinya yang kaya, pola negasi yang kompleks, dan perangkat NLP yang terbatas dibandingkan dengan bahasa yang memiliki sumber daya melimpah. Sistem yang diusulkan bertujuan untuk menggantikan penilaian manusia yang subjektif dengan asesmen otomatis yang dapat *skalabel*, konsisten, dan dapat diulang.

contributions.en:
The primary contributions of this paper include a complete and reproducible Hindi evaluation pipeline designed specifically for primary school reading comprehension tasks. The authors perform systematic hyperparameter optimization via grid search over learning rates and batch sizes to identify optimal training configurations.

Furthermore, the study provides empirical benchmarking that achieves an accuracy of 78.9% on the HindiRC-Data-master dataset, outperforming baseline models significantly. Finally, the paper offers a transparent analysis of system limitations along with a clear roadmap for future improvements.
contributions.id:
Kontribusi utama dari makalah ini meliputi *pipeline* evaluasi bahasa Hindi yang lengkap dan dapat direproduksi yang dirancang khusus untuk tugas pemahaman bacaan sekolah dasar. Para penulis melakukan optimasi *hiperparameter* secara sistematis melalui *grid search* pada *learning rate* dan *batch size* untuk mengidentifikasi konfigurasi pelatihan yang optimal.

Selain itu, studi ini memberikan *benchmarking* empiris yang mencapai akurasi 78.9% pada *dataset* HindiRC-Data-master, mengungguli model *baseline* secara signifikan. Terakhir, makalah ini menawarkan analisis transparan tentang keterbatasan sistem beserta peta jalan yang jelas untuk perbaikan di masa depan.

future_work.en: Future work should focus on five key directions to address current limitations. First, expanding the training corpus to include passages from grades 6 to 10 and STEM subjects, targeting at least 1,000 QA pairs. Second, incorporating explicit negation handling through a dedicated preprocessing step. Third, exploring alternative pretrained models such as MuRIL or L3Cube-HindBERT for potential accuracy gains. Fourth, investigating generative sequence-to-sequence models to overcome single-word output constraints. Finally, benchmarking open-source Hindi-capable large language models against the proposed pipeline.
future_work.id: Pekerjaan di masa depan harus fokus pada lima arah utama untuk mengatasi keterbatasan saat ini. Pertama, memperluas korpus pelatihan untuk menyertakan bacaan dari kelas 6 hingga 10 dan subjek STEM, menargetkan setidaknya 1.000 pasang QA. Kedua, menggabungkan penanganan negasi eksplisit melalui langkah pra-pemrosesan khusus. Ketiga, mengeksplorasi model *pre-trained* alternatif seperti MuRIL atau L3Cube-HindBERT untuk potensi peningkatan akurasi. Keempat, menyelidiki model *generative sequence-to-sequence* untuk mengatasi batasan keluaran satu kata. Terakhir, melakukan *benchmarking* pada *large language model* sumber terbuka yang mampu berbahasa Hindi terhadap *pipeline* yang diusulkan.

method.en:
The proposed framework operates in two main phases: a fine-tuning phase for answer span extraction and an evaluation phase for semantic similarity scoring. The dataset consists of 127 question-answer pairs extracted from 24 reading comprehension passages across grades 2 to 5, split into 101 training pairs and 26 evaluation pairs. Data preprocessing involves stripping extraneous characters, removing Hindi stop words, and applying stemming and lemmatization to collapse morphological variants, reducing the vocabulary size by 62 percent.

The fine-tuning phase uses the bhavikardeshna/multilingual-bert-base-cased-hindi model, trained with the AdamW optimizer, gradient clipping, and a linear warm-up scheduler. For the scoring phase, the l3cube-pune/hindi-sentence-similarity-sbert model produces 768-dimensional dense sentence embeddings via mean pooling. Cosine similarity is computed between predicted and reference answers, using an empirical classification threshold of tau equals 0.2 to categorize predictions as correct or incorrect.
method.id:
Kerangka kerja yang diusulkan beroperasi dalam dua fase utama: fase *fine-tuning* untuk ekstraksi rentang jawaban dan fase evaluasi untuk penilaian kemiripan semantik. *Dataset* ini terdiri dari 127 pasang pertanyaan-jawaban yang diekstrak dari 24 bacaan pemahaman dari kelas 2 hingga 5, yang dibagi menjadi 101 pasang pelatihan dan 26 pasang evaluasi. Pra-pemrosesan data melibatkan penghilangan karakter asing, penghapusan *stop word* bahasa Hindi, serta penerapan *stemming* dan *lemmatization* untuk menyatukan varian morfologi, yang mengurangi ukuran kosa kata sebesar 62 persen.

Fase *fine-tuning* menggunakan model bhavikardeshna/multilingual-bert-base-cased-hindi, yang dilatih dengan *optimizer* AdamW, *gradient clipping*, dan penjadwal *linear warm-up*. Untuk fase penilaian, model l3cube-pune/hindi-sentence-similarity-sbert menghasilkan *dense sentence embedding* berdimensi 768 melalui *mean pooling*. Kemiripan kosinus dihitung antara jawaban prediksi dan referensi, menggunakan ambang batas klasifikasi empiris sebesar tau sama dengan 0.2 untuk mengkategorikan prediksi benar atau salah.

related_work.en:
The automated scoring of descriptive responses has evolved from early Latent Semantic Analysis-based systems like Intelligent Essay Assessor and GradeAid, which fail to capture word order and negation. Subsequent research explored machine learning approaches, ensemble methods, and deep learning architectures such as CNN-LSTM models for short answer grading in various languages including Arabic and Hindi. In multilingual scenarios, prior works utilized multilingual BERT ensembles for comprehension tasks, while models like Sentence-BERT introduced efficient dense sentence embeddings using cosine similarity to reduce computational overhead.

Other notable studies investigated transformer-based automated short answer grading and domain-specific pre-training to overcome limited training data. While recent works have explored Large Language Models such as GPT-4 for grading, they face significant challenges regarding explainability, inference costs, and availability in low-resource languages. The present study builds upon these foundations by utilizing domain-adapted multilingual BERT variants and specialized sentence similarity models.
related_work.id:
Skor otomatis untuk respons deskriptif telah berkembang dari sistem awal berbasis *Latent Semantic Analysis* seperti Intelligent Essay Assessor dan GradeAid, yang gagal menangkap urutan kata dan negasi. Penelitian selanjutnya mengeksplorasi pendekatan *machine learning*, metode *ensemble*, dan arsitektur *deep learning* seperti model CNN-LSTM untuk penilaian jawaban singkat dalam berbagai bahasa termasuk bahasa Arab dan Hindi. Dalam skenario *multilingual*, karya-karya sebelumnya memanfaatkan *ensemble* BERT *multilingual* untuk tugas pemahaman, sementara model seperti Sentence-BERT memperkenalkan *dense sentence embedding* yang efisien menggunakan kesamaan kosinus untuk mengurangi beban komputasi.

Studi penting lainnya menyelidiki penilaian jawaban singkat otomatis berbasis *transformer* dan *pre-training* spesifik domain untuk mengatasi keterbatasan data pelatihan. Meskipun karya-karya terbaru telah mengeksplorasi *large language model* seperti GPT-4 untuk penilaian, mereka menghadapi tantangan signifikan terkait keterjelasan (*explainability*), biaya inferensi, dan ketersediaan dalam bahasa *low-resource*. Studi saat ini dibangun di atas fondasi ini dengan memanfaatkan varian mBERT *multilingual* yang diadaptasi domain dan model kemiripan kalimat khusus.

results.en:
The proposed mBERT system achieved an accuracy of 78.9%, precision of 80.6%, recall of 77.4%, and an F1-score of 79.0% on the test set. This represents a 14.2 percentage point improvement over the BM25 lexical baseline, which scored 64.7% in accuracy. To validate these findings, the authors computed Cohen's Kappa coefficient, obtaining kappa equals 0.71, which indicates substantial inter-rater agreement with a human expert.

Hyperparameter analysis revealed that a learning rate of 5 multiplied by 10 to the power of -4 combined with a batch size of 24 achieved the best performance. Embedding space visualizations through 2D PCA demonstrated substantial overlap between actual and predicted answer clusters, confirming the effectiveness of the semantic space alignment. Error analysis identified single-word answer span inaccuracies, implicit negation questions, and long passages exceeding 120 tokens as the primary failure modes.
results.id:
Sistem mBERT yang diusulkan mencapai akurasi 78.9%, presisi 80.6%, *recall* 77.4%, dan *F1-score* 79.0% pada *set* pengujian. Ini merupakan peningkatan sebesar 14.2 persentase poin dari *baseline* leksikal BM25, yang memperoleh akurasi 64.7%. Untuk memvalidasi temuan ini, para penulis menghitung koefisien Cohen's Kappa, memperoleh *kappa* sama dengan 0.71, yang menunjukkan kesepakatan antarpenilai yang substansial dengan ahli manusia.

Analisis *hiperparameter* mengungkapkan bahwa *learning rate* sebesar 5 dikalikan 10 pangkat -4 yang dikombinasikan dengan *batch size* 24 mencapai performa terbaik. Visualisasi ruang *embedding* melalui PCA 2D menunjukkan tumpang tindih yang substansial antara klaster jawaban aktual dan prediksi, yang mengkonfirmasi efektivitas penyelarasan ruang semantik. Analisis kesalahan mengidentifikasi ketidakakuratan rentang jawaban satu kata, pertanyaan negasi implisit, dan bacaan panjang yang melebihi 120 token sebagai mode kegagalan utama.

tldr.en: This study proposes an automated evaluation framework for Hindi descriptive answers using a fine-tuned mBERT model and SBERT-based semantic alignment. The system achieves 78.9% accuracy on the HindiRC-Data-master dataset, outperforming lexical baselines by over 14%.
tldr.id: Studi ini mengusulkan kerangka evaluasi otomatis untuk jawaban deskriptif bahasa Hindi menggunakan model *fine-tuning* mBERT dan penyelarasan semantik berbasis SBERT. Sistem ini mencapai akurasi 78.9% pada *dataset* HindiRC-Data-master, mengungguli *baseline* leksikal lebih dari 14%.

doi:10.14500/aro.12814.abstract: Stance detection has become a fundamental task in natural language processing (NLP), yet it remains under-explored for low-resource languages such as Sorani Kurdish. Building on the previously released Bochun dataset, the present work focuses exclusively on the comprehensive evaluation of stance detection models and provides the first benchmarking of classical machine learning, deep learning (DL), and transformers. Eight models are implemented: Support vector machine (SVM), logistic regression, random forest, extreme gradient boosting, convolutional neural network, bidirectional long short-term memory, and two frozen transformer encoders, Central Kurdish Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) and XLM-RoBERTa-base (XLM-R), each combined with a logistic-regression classification head. All models are trained and evaluated under four protocols (80/20 and 70/30 stratified splits and 5-fold and 10-fold cross-validation) with five random seeds. Class-imbalance handling is investigated through a dedicated ablation comparing no weighting, model-appropriate weighting, and Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique oversampling, and pairwise statistical comparisons are conducted using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests complemented by Cohen’s d effect sizes. With the chosen feature representations and dataset size, the SVM trained on term frequency–inverse document frequency features delivers the strongest performance (accuracy and weighted F1 of 74% on the 80/20 split and 72% under 10-fold cross-validation), outperforming the DL and frozen-transformer baselines. The findings provide a foundational reference point for future research on Kurdish NLP in general and stance detection specifically.

glossary.explanation_id: Tugas pemrosesan bahasa alami untuk menentukan apakah suatu teks mendukung, menolak, atau bersikap netral terhadap target tertentu.
Metode representasi teks statistik yang mengukur seberapa penting suatu kata dalam dokumen relatif terhadap korpus.
Teknik evaluasi model dengan membagi data menjadi beberapa bagian untuk pelatihan dan pengujian secara berulang guna memastikan ketahanan model.
Teknik *oversampling* yang menghasilkan sampel sintetis untuk kelas minoritas guna mengatasi ketidakseimbangan data.
Metode evaluasi di mana *encoder* dibekukan dan hanya pengklasifikasi linier di atasnya yang dilatih pada data hilir.
Eksperimen yang dilakukan untuk mengisolasi dan memahami kontribusi komponen atau pengaturan tertentu terhadap performa sistem.
Uji statistik non-parametrik yang digunakan untuk membandingkan dua kelompok data berpasangan guna menilai signifikansi perbedaan.
Ukuran ukuran efek statistik yang digunakan untuk menunjukkan besarnya perbedaan antara dua kelompok hasil model.

background.en: Automated stance detection determines whether a piece of text supports, opposes, or remains neutral on a specific target, which is crucial for applications such as social-media monitoring and political analysis. While significant progress has been achieved for high-resource languages, low-resource languages like Sorani Kurdish remain under-represented due to the scarcity of annotated datasets, lexicons, and computational tools compounded by rich morphology and dialectal variations.
background.id: *Stance detection* otomatis menentukan apakah sebuah teks mendukung, menolak, atau bersikap netral terhadap target tertentu, yang sangat penting untuk aplikasi seperti pemantauan media sosial dan analisis politik. Meskipun kemajuan signifikan telah dicapai untuk bahasa dengan sumber daya melimpah, bahasa dengan sumber daya rendah seperti Sorani Kurdish tetap kurang terwakili karena kelangkaan *dataset* beranotasi, leksikon, dan alat komputasi yang diperparah oleh morfologi yang kaya serta variasi dialek.

contributions.en: This paper provides the first systematic evaluation and benchmarking of stance detection models for Sorani Kurdish using the Bochun dataset. The contributions include evaluating eight diverse classifiers across classical machine learning, deep learning, and frozen transformers, conducting a dedicated ablation study on class-imbalance handling, and performing pairwise statistical significance tests using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and Cohen's d effect sizes.
contributions.id: Makalah ini menyediakan evaluasi sistematis dan *benchmark* pertama untuk model *stance detection* pada Sorani Kurdish menggunakan *dataset* Bochun. Kontribusinya meliputi evaluasi delapan pengklasifikasi berbeda yang mencakup *machine learning* klasik, *deep learning*, dan *transformer* yang dibekukan, melakukan studi ablasi khusus pada penanganan ketidakseimbangan kelas, serta melakukan uji signifikansi statistik berpasangan menggunakan uji *Wilcoxon signed-rank* dan ukuran efek *Cohen's d*.

future_work.en: The authors state several limitations and future directions, including extending the unit of analysis from titles to full body text to exploit distributed rhetorical cues, increasing the seed budget and dataset scale across new thematic domains and dialects, and implementing full fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, or domain-adaptive pretraining to bridge the performance gap of transformers.
future_work.id: Para penulis menyatakan beberapa keterbatasan dan arah masa depan, termasuk memperluas unit analisis dari judul ke teks tubuh lengkap untuk mengeksploitasi petunjuk retoris terdistribusi, meningkatkan anggaran *seed* dan skala *dataset* di berbagai domain tematik dan dialek baru, serta mengimplementasikan *fine-tuning* penuh, *parameter-efficient fine-tuning*, atau *domain-adaptive pretraining* untuk menjembatani kesenjangan performa dari *transformer*.

method.en: The study utilizes the Bochun dataset containing 2,174 economic and political article titles preprocessed with the Kurdish Language Processing Toolkit. Eight models spanning classical machine learning (SVM, logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost), deep learning (CNN, BiLSTM), and frozen transformers (KuBERT, XLM-R) are evaluated under four protocols including stratified splits and k-fold cross-validation with five random seeds. Training incorporates model-appropriate weighting schemes to address class imbalance.
method.id: Penelitian ini menggunakan *dataset* Bochun yang berisi 2.174 judul artikel ekonomi dan politik yang diproses sebelumnya dengan *Kurdish Language Processing Toolkit*. Delapan model yang mencakup *machine learning* klasik (*SVM*, *logistic regression*, *random forest*, *XGBoost*), *deep learning* (*CNN*, *BiLSTM*), dan *transformer* yang dibekukan (*KuBERT*, *XLM-R*) dievaluasi di bawah empat protokol yang mencakup *stratified split* dan *k-fold cross-validation* dengan lima *random seed*. Pelatihan menggabungkan skema pembobotan yang sesuai dengan model untuk mengatasi ketidakseimbangan kelas.

related_work.en: Previous research has explored stance detection across various languages such as English, Arabic, Turkish, and Persian using SemEval tasks, custom datasets, and hybrid neural architectures. However, low-resource languages like Kurdish have minimal coverage in this area, lacking dedicated stance-detection datasets and consistent benchmarks, which leaves the transferability of deep learning and transformer-based models to low-resource Kurdish as an open empirical question.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya telah mengeksplorasi *stance detection* di berbagai bahasa seperti Inggris, Arab, Turki, dan Persia menggunakan tugas SemEval, *dataset* kustom, dan arsitektur saraf hibrida. Namun, bahasa dengan sumber daya rendah seperti bahasa Kurdi memiliki cakupan minimal di bidang ini, kurang memiliki *dataset* *stance detection* khusus dan *benchmark* yang konsisten, sehingga transferabilitas model *deep learning* dan berbasis *transformer* ke bahasa Sorani Kurdish yang bersumber daya rendah masih menjadi pertanyaan empiris yang terbuka.

results.en: The SVM model trained on TF-IDF features achieved the strongest performance, yielding an accuracy and weighted F1 of 74% on the 80/20 split and 72% under 10-fold cross-validation, outperforming deep learning and frozen transformer baselines. The CNN model outperformed BiLSTM by capturing localized n-gram dependencies from short titles, while frozen transformers underperformed due to the small dataset size and lack of full fine-tuning. Class-imbalance ablation showed that appropriate weighting successfully recovered minority-class performance without the destructive effects observed when using SMOTE on sequence embeddings.
results.id: Model *SVM* yang dilatih pada fitur TF-IDF mencapai performa terkuat, menghasilkan akurasi dan *weighted F1* sebesar 74% pada pembagian 80/20 dan 72% di bawah *10-fold cross-validation*, mengungguli *baseline* *deep learning* dan *transformer* yang dibekukan. Model *CNN* mengungguli *BiLSTM* dengan menangkap dependensi *n-gram* lokal dari judul pendek, sementara *transformer* yang dibekukan berkinerja lebih rendah karena ukuran *dataset* yang kecil dan kurangnya *fine-tuning* penuh. Ablasi ketidakseimbangan kelas menunjukkan bahwa pembobotan yang tepat berhasil memulihkan performa kelas minoritas tanpa efek destruktif yang diamati saat menggunakan *SMOTE* pada *embedding* sekuens.

tldr.en: This paper presents the first comprehensive evaluation of stance detection models for the Sorani Kurdish language using the Bochun dataset. The findings show that a support vector machine trained on TF-IDF features outperforms deep learning and frozen transformer baselines.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan evaluasi komprehensif pertama mengenai model *stance detection* untuk bahasa Sorani Kurdish menggunakan *dataset* Bochun. Temuan utamanya menunjukkan bahwa *support vector machine* yang dilatih dengan fitur TF-IDF mengungguli *baseline* *deep learning* dan *transformer* yang dibekukan.

doi:10.1515/libri-2025-0042.abstract: Abstract The expansion of Google Translate support to Philippine regional languages, including Bicolano, Hiligaynon, Kapampangan, Pangasinense, and Waray, highlights the growing recognition of linguistic diversity in digital spaces. Despite these advances, AI tools’ effectiveness in handling regional linguistic diversity remains underexplored. Looking into AI’s capabilities to handle less-represented languages, this study investigates AI-driven research tools’ ability to process multilingual queries in these languages, focusing on how tools like ChatGPT, Elicit, and Semantic Scholar retrieve, translate, and interpret search queries. Through qualitative analysis, the study evaluates the effectiveness of these tools in retrieving relevant information and addressing linguistic complexities. Findings reveal that while ChatGPT provides relevant responses, they are often brief, lacking deeper contextual understanding. Elicit, on the other hand, produces accurate literal translations but struggles with irrelevant results, poor abstract summarization, and occasional confabulation. Semantic Scholar presents additional challenges, delivering inconsistent results with accuracy issues, a lack of translation features, and frequent hallucinations. The study emphasizes the need for AI systems to improve their ability to process regional linguistic contextual intricacies, advocating for the development of more inclusive and context-aware AI tools to enhance information access. As champions of information equity, librarians must take a proactive role by staying informed, experimenting with AI tools, and continuously refining their practice, shaping how AI influences knowledge access, ensuring inclusivity, and representation of diverse languages.

contributions.en: This study investigates the ability of popular AI-driven research tools to process multilingual queries in Philippine regional languages. It evaluates how tools like ChatGPT, Elicit, and Semantic Scholar retrieve, translate, and interpret search queries.

Elicit produces accurate literal translations but suffers from irrelevant results, poor abstract summarization, and occasional confabulation, while Semantic Scholar delivers inconsistent results, lacks translation features, and frequently hallucinates.

Elicit menghasilkan terjemahan harafiah yang akurat namun terkendala oleh hasil yang tidak relevan, buruknya peringkasan abstrak, serta konfabulasi sesekali, sementara Semantic Scholar memberikan hasil yang tidak konsisten, tidak memiliki fitur terjemahan, dan sering berhalusinasi.

tldr.en: This study investigates how AI-driven research tools process multilingual queries in Philippine regional languages. The findings reveal significant limitations across platforms in handling contextual intricacies, translation, and information retrieval.

doi:10.1515/lingvan-2024-0241.abstract: Abstract During public health crises, rapid dissemination of accurate information in the languages spoken by vulnerable populations is a matter of linguistic justice and, in many cases, a determinant of survival. Although machine translation (MT) systems constitute a scalable solution for multilingual crisis communication, low-resource languages such as West African varieties of Pidgin remain effectively excluded from these technologies owing to the absence of standardized orthography, terminological resources, and parallel corpora. This study examines the obstacles developers would face when integrating COVID-19 terminology into MT systems for Pidgin English. Drawing on a corpus of over 20,000 Cameroon Pidgin English tokens scraped from Facebook at the height of the pandemic and analysed with Sketch Engine, we investigate how speakers rendered key public health concepts, identify the predominant translation strategies, and document the resulting challenges for terminology compilation and downstream MT integration. The analysis focuses on orthographic variation, domain specificity, annotation consistency, preprocessing requirements, and ethical considerations surrounding community consent and representation. The study highlights linguistic and technical barriers preventing Pidgin-speaking communities from benefiting from automated crisis-translation tools and underscores the urgent need for community-driven terminological resources as a prerequisite for inclusive MT development in low-resource settings.

Meskipun sistem *machine translation* menawarkan solusi yang dapat diukur untuk komunikasi krisis multibahasa, bahasa *low-resource* seperti varietas Pidgin Afrika Barat tetap dikecualikan secara efektif karena tidak adanya ortografi standar, sumber daya terminologi, dan *parallel corpora*.

contributions.en: This study investigates the obstacles developers face when integrating COVID-19 terminology into machine translation systems for Pidgin English. It examines how speakers rendered key public health concepts, identifies predominant translation strategies, and documents resulting challenges for terminology compilation and downstream machine translation integration.
contributions.id: Studi ini menyelidiki hambatan yang dihadapi pengembang saat mengintegrasikan terminologi COVID-19 ke dalam sistem *machine translation* untuk Pidgin English. Penelitian ini meneliti bagaimana penutur mengalihbahasakan konsep kesehatan masyarakat utama, mengidentifikasi strategi terjemahan yang dominan, dan mendokumentasikan tantangan yang dihasilkan untuk kompilasi terminologi serta integrasi *machine translation* hilir.

Analisis berfokus pada variasi ortografi, spesifisitas domain, konsistensi *anotasi*, persyaratan prapemrosesan, dan pertimbangan etis seputar persetujuan serta representasi komunitas.

The authors interpret these findings by underscoring the urgent need for community-driven terminological resources as a prerequisite for inclusive machine translation development in low-resource settings.
results.id: Studi ini menyoroti hambatan linguistik dan teknis yang mencegah komunitas penutur Pidgin mendapatkan manfaat dari alat terjemahan krisis otomatis. Para penulis menginterpretasikan temuan ini dengan menekankan kebutuhan mendesak akan sumber daya terminologi yang digerakkan oleh komunitas sebagai prasyarat untuk pengembangan *machine translation* yang inklusif dalam pengaturan *low-resource*.

tldr.en: This study examines the obstacles of developing Pidgin English-English bilingual resources for machine translation during public health crises. The findings highlight significant linguistic and technical barriers, underscoring the urgent need for community-driven terminological resources in low-resource settings.
tldr.id: Studi ini mengkaji hambatan pengembangan sumber daya dwibahasawan Pidgin English-Inggris untuk *machine translation* selama krisis kesehatan masyarakat. Temuan ini menyoroti kendala linguistik dan teknis yang signifikan, serta menekankan kebutuhan mendesak akan sumber daya terminologi yang digerakkan oleh komunitas pada pengaturan *low-resource*.

doi:10.1515/phon-2025-0072.abstract: This paper explores the integration of human linguistic insights into multilingual text-to-speech (TTS) systems by evaluating the Featurally Underspecified Lexicon (FUL) as a theory-driven input representation. Unlike data-intensive end-to end models, FUL offers a compact, interpretable feature set grounded in phonological principles, enabling scalable and equitable TTS development for low-resource languages. We provide a mapping from language-specific phones to FUL feature vectors via a SAMPA intermediate and incorporate these features into a modified FastSpeech architecture. Experiments were conducted to evaluate their ability to generate native, non-native, and code-mixed speech in English and Mandarin. We ran an experiment with a small dataset and one with a larger dataset, which showed that TTS with FUL features as input could produce intelligible native speech with as little as 8 h of training data; with 100 h of training data, intelligible speech could be generated for a language not present in the training data. The approach further supports code-mixed synthesis while preserving consistent timbre and interpretable phonetic control. These results highlight the potential of theory-driven representations for building efficient, scalable, and linguistically informed TTS systems, demonstrating that phonological features can function as both analytical tools and practical inputs for speech technology.

glossary.explanation_id: Teknologi *text-to-speech* adalah sistem komputasi yang mengubah teks tertulis menjadi bentuk ujaran suara manusia.
*Featurally Underspecified Lexicon* adalah representasi leksikon yang menggunakan himpunan fitur fonologis yang ringkas dan didorong oleh teori.
Arsitektur *end-to-end* melatih seluruh komponen sistem secara langsung dari masukan hingga keluaran dalam satu proses terpadu.
Bahasa *low-resource* adalah bahasa yang memiliki ketersediaan korpus, data teks, atau sumber daya komputasi yang sangat terbatas.
*FastSpeech* adalah salah satu arsitektur model *text-to-speech* non-regresif yang populer untuk sintesis suara.
Kemampuan *zero-shot* memungkinkan model melakukan tugas pada kelas atau bahasa yang sama sekali tidak pernah dilihat selama pelatihan.
Ujaran *code-mixed* melibatkan penggunaan dua bahasa atau lebih secara bergantian dalam satu kalimat atau wacana yang sama.
Sistem SAMPA digunakan sebagai representasi perantara fonetik berbasis abjad ASCII untuk berbagai bahasa.

background.en: Data-intensive end-to-end models often struggle in resource-constrained environments, highlighting the need for efficient and equitable approaches. This paper addresses the gap by exploring the integration of human linguistic insights into multilingual text-to-speech systems through theory-driven input representations.
background.id: Model *end-to-end* yang haus data sering kali mengalami kendala di lingkungan dengan sumber daya terbatas, sehingga menyoroti perlunya pendekatan yang efisien dan berkeadilan. Makalah ini mengatasi kesenjangan tersebut dengan mengeksplorasi integrasi wawasan linguistik manusia ke dalam sistem *text-to-speech* multilinguial melalui representasi masukan berbasis teori.

contributions.en: The paper introduces the Featurally Underspecified Lexicon as a compact, interpretable feature set grounded in phonological principles for multilingual text-to-speech development. It provides a mapping from language-specific phones to feature vectors via a SAMPA intermediate and incorporates them into a modified FastSpeech architecture.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan *Featurally Underspecified Lexicon* sebagai rangkaian fitur yang ringkas dan dapat diinterpretasikan berdasarkan prinsip-prinsip fonologis untuk pengembangan *text-to-speech* multilinguial. Makalah ini menyediakan pemetaan dari *phone* spesifik bahasa ke vektor fitur melalui perantara SAMPA dan memasukkannya ke dalam arsitektur *FastSpeech* yang dimodifikasi.

method.en: The approach maps language-specific phones to Featurally Underspecified Lexicon feature vectors using a SAMPA intermediate representation, which are then integrated into a modified FastSpeech architecture. Experiments were conducted using both small and large datasets to evaluate speech generation capabilities in native, non-native, and code-mixed settings for English and Mandarin.

Eksperimen dilakukan menggunakan dataset kecil dan besar untuk mengevaluasi kemampuan pembuatan ujaran dalam pengaturan asli, non-asli, dan *code-mixed* untuk bahasa Inggris dan Mandarin.

results.en: Experiments showed that text-to-speech with Featurally Underspecified Lexicon features can produce intelligible native speech with only 8 hours of training data. Furthermore, with 100 hours of training data, intelligible speech could be generated for a language not present in the training data, while also supporting code-mixed synthesis with consistent timbre and phonetic control.
results.id: Eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa *text-to-speech* dengan fitur *Featurally Underspecified Lexicon* dapat menghasilkan ujaran asli yang dapat dipahami hanya dengan 8 jam data pelatihan. Selain itu, dengan 100 jam data pelatihan, ujaran yang dapat dipahami dapat dihasilkan untuk bahasa yang tidak ada dalam data pelatihan, sekaligus mendukung sintesis *code-mixed* dengan timbre yang konsisten dan kontrol fonetik yang dapat diinterpretasikan.

tldr.en: This paper integrates human linguistic insights into multilingual text-to-speech systems by evaluating the Featurally Underspecified Lexicon as a theory-driven input representation. The findings show that this approach enables the generation of intelligible native speech with minimal data and supports zero-shot synthesis for unseen languages.
tldr.id: Makalah ini mengintegrasikan wawasan linguistik manusia ke dalam sistem *text-to-speech* multilinguial dengan mengevaluasi *Featurally Underspecified Lexicon* sebagai representasi masukan berbasis teori. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa pendekatan ini memungkinkan pembuatan ujaran asli yang dapat dipahami dengan data minimal dan mendukung sintesis *zero-shot* untuk bahasa yang belum pernah dilihat.

doi:10.15294/rji.v4i2.62866.abstract: This study develops an academic chatbot based on Natural Language Processing (NLP) to support student information services at Universitas Bina Darma. The system was developed using an engineering research approach by combining questionnaire data from 100 active students with verified academic service information. The implementation integrates WhatsApp through Baileys, a Node.js backend, Dialogflow ES for intent and entity processing, and MySQL for conversation logging. The final agent contains 129 custom intents, 22 entities, and 2,572 cleaned training phrases representing formal and informal Indonesian student queries. A confidence threshold of 0.70 is applied to determine whether the system provides a standard response or fallback response. Evaluation included 13 black-box scenarios, 24 intent tests, 15 response tests, and 6 integration scenarios. The results showed 95.83% intent recognition, 86.67% response conformity, and 100.00% integration success, while all black-box scenarios produced the expected outputs. These findings indicate that the developed system can reliably support routine academic information requests through WhatsApp, although response coverage and alignment remain areas for further improvement.

glossary.explanation_id: Intent adalah kategori maksud atau tujuan dari kalimat yang diucapkan oleh pengguna agar dapat dipahami oleh *natural language processing*.
Entity merujuk pada informasi spesifik atau parameter penting yang diekstrak dari teks masukan pengguna.
Backend adalah bagian dari arsitektur perangkat lunak yang berjalan di peladen untuk mengelola logika aplikasi dan basis data.
Confidence threshold adalah batas nilai keyakinan minimum yang digunakan model untuk menentukan apakah suatu prediksi dapat diterima.
Black-box adalah metode pengujian perangkat lunak yang berfokus pada fungsionalitas keluaran tanpa melihat struktur internal kode.

background.en: Higher education institutions require efficient student information services to handle routine inquiries regarding academic administration. Traditional manual handling often leads to delays and high workloads for administrative staff. This study addresses the gap by developing an automated academic chatbot tailored for student services at Universitas Bina Darma.
background.id: Institusi perguruan tinggi memerlukan layanan informasi mahasiswa yang efisien untuk menangani pertanyaan rutin seputar administrasi akademik. Penanganan manual tradisional sering kali memicu keterlambatan dan beban kerja yang tinggi bagi staf administratif. Studi ini mengatasi kesenjangan tersebut dengan mengembangkan *academic chatbot* otomatis yang disesuaikan untuk layanan mahasiswa di Universitas Bina Darma.

contributions.en: The study contributes a fully functional academic chatbot integrated with WhatsApp, featuring 129 custom intents, 22 entities, and 2,572 cleaned training phrases based on student questionnaires and verified university data.
contributions.id: Studi ini berkontribusi menyediakan *academic chatbot* yang berfungsi penuh dan terintegrasi dengan *WhatsApp*, yang dilengkapi dengan 129 *custom intent*, 22 *entity*, serta 2.572 *training phrase* bersih yang didasarkan pada kuesioner mahasiswa dan data universitas yang terverifikasi.

future_work.en: The authors state that response coverage and alignment remain areas for further improvement.
future_work.id: Penulis menyatakan bahwa cakupan respons dan keselarasan tetap menjadi aspek yang perlu ditingkatkan lebih lanjut.

method.en: The system was built using an engineering research approach combining questionnaire data from 100 active students and verified service information. The implementation integrates a Node.js backend using Baileys for WhatsApp, Dialogflow ES for intent and entity processing, and MySQL for logging, employing a confidence threshold of 0.70 and rigorous testing scenarios.
method.id: Sistem dibangun menggunakan pendekatan riset rekayasa yang menggabungkan data kuesioner dari 100 mahasiswa aktif dan informasi layanan terverifikasi. Implementasinya mengintegrasikan *backend* *Node.js* menggunakan *Baileys* untuk *WhatsApp*, *Dialogflow ES* untuk pemrosesan *intent* dan *entity*, serta *MySQL* untuk pencatatan, dengan menerapkan *confidence threshold* sebesar 0,70 dan skenario pengujian yang ketat.

results.en: Evaluation results across black-box, intent, response, and integration tests showed 95.83 percent intent recognition, 86.67 percent response conformity, and 100 percent integration success, with all black-box scenarios yielding expected outputs.
results.id: Hasil evaluasi melalui pengujian *black-box*, *intent*, respons, dan integrasi menunjukkan tingkat pengenalan *intent* sebesar 95,83 persen, kesesuaian respons sebesar 86,67 persen, dan keberhasilan integrasi sebesar 100 persen, di mana seluruh skenario *black-box* menghasilkan keluaran yang diharapkan.

tldr.en: This study develops a natural language processing-based academic chatbot to support student information services at Universitas Bina Darma. The evaluation demonstrates high intent recognition, response conformity, and integration success through WhatsApp.
tldr.id: Studi ini mengembangkan *academic chatbot* berbasis *natural language processing* untuk mendukung layanan informasi mahasiswa di Universitas Bina Darma. Evaluasi menunjukkan tingkat pengenalan *intent*, kesesuaian respons, dan keberhasilan integrasi yang tinggi melalui *WhatsApp*.

doi:10.15294/rji.v4i2.62938.abstract: Manual administrative processes at ITEBIS PGRI Dewantara Jombang frequently cause delayed student feedback and overload staff with repetitive questions. To solve this issue, this research developed a 24-hour academic chatbot prototype that integrates a fine-tuned IndoBERT model within an extractive Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework. The indobenchmark/indobert-base-p1 model was trained over five epochs using a dataset of 2,517 SQuAD-formatted academic question-and-answer pairs. For the architecture, the system employs Laravel to manage the frontend interface and relies on FastAPI as the backend to run the RAG pipeline. Upon evaluating the model using 504 validation pairs, the algorithm obtained an Exact Match (EM) accuracy of 71.32% and an F1-Score of 86.63%. In addition, functional black-box testing verified that the web application effectively extracts and displays accurate, real-time answers straight from a dynamic database. The primary novelty of this research is the implementation of RAG alongside IndoBERT specifically for Indonesian conversational systems, which eliminates the need to constantly retrain standard closed-book models. Ultimately, this paper offers practical end-to-end documentation on how to deploy a Natural Language Processing model into a fully operational web environment.

Proses melatih ulang model bahasa prarilis pada data spesifik agar kinerjanya meningkat pada tugas tertentu.
Metrik evaluasi yang mengukur persentase prediksi yang sama persis dengan teks acuan yang sebenarnya.
Metrik evaluasi yang menghitung rerata harmonis dari *precision* dan *recall* suatu model.

background.en: Manual administrative processes at ITEBIS PGRI Dewantara Jombang frequently cause delayed student feedback and overload staff with repetitive questions. This inefficiency highlights the need for automated solutions to handle routine inquiries effectively.

doi:10.17102/zmv9.i1.017.abstract: Dzongkha is a low-resource language. Lack of a parallel Speech-to-speech translation dataset is a major challenge. This paper introduces a novel method for curating the first Dzongkha-English speech parallel corpus. The proposed method uses divergent TTS models to synthesize aligned speech from translated text pairs. Furthermore, Google’s gTTS is used for English, and a tonally adjusted Tacotron2 system for Dzongkha. The dataset includes 7,385 Dzongkha ASR audio-text pairs, 419,731 Dzongkha-English machine translation text pairs, 1,530 Dzongkha TTS audio-text pairs, and 240 hours of synthetic speech data each for Speech-to-Unit and Dzongkha Unit-to-Speech tasks. The dataset curation pipeline entails rigorous text normalization, 22.05kHz dual-language audio recording, and three-stage signal conditioning-noise reduction, silence truncation, and EBU R128 loudness normalization. Most notably, we use tool-assisted temporal alignment followed by human verification to ensure sub-second synchronism of utterances. By rejecting 8.7% of samples via PESQ quality thresholds, we ensure acoustic consistency. This work constructs a scalable method for producing high-fidelity parallel speech data for under-resourced languages directly facilitating S2ST model development in the lack of natural datasets.

glossary.explanation_id: Tacotron2 adalah sebuah model arsitektur *neural network* generatif yang digunakan untuk mensintesis ucapan alami langsung dari teks.
PESQ adalah standar objektif yang digunakan untuk menilai kualitas persepsi sinyal wicara yang telah diproses atau ditransmisikan.
ASR adalah teknologi yang memungkinkan sistem komputer mengenali dan mentranskripsikan kata-kata yang diucapkan menjadi teks.
TTS adalah teknologi yang mengubah data teks tertulis menjadi keluaran suara ucapan sintetis.
Vocoder adalah komponen model yang bertugas merekonstruksi sinyal gelombang suara akhir dari representasi fitur akustik.
LibROSA adalah pustaka perangkat lunak berbasis Python yang banyak digunakan untuk analisis musik dan pemrosesan sinyal audio.

background.en: Dzongkha is the national language of Bhutan, featuring a tonal Sino-Tibetan structure, agglutinative morphology, and a classical Tibetan script. As a low-resource language, it suffers from a critical lack of parallel speech-to-speech translation datasets, hindering the development of advanced speech technologies for education, healthcare, and government services.
background.id: Dzongkha adalah bahasa nasional Bhutan yang memiliki struktur Sino-Tibetan bernada, morfologi aglutinatif, dan aksara Tibet klasik. Sebagai bahasa *low-resource*, bahasa ini mengalami kekurangan kritis berupa dataset paralel *speech-to-speech translation*, sehingga menghambat pengembangan teknologi wicara tingkat lanjut untuk pendidikan, layanan kesehatan, dan layanan pemerintah.

contributions.en: This paper presents the first parallel Dzongkha-English speech corpus and a scalable curation pipeline using divergent text-to-speech models. The contributions include 7,385 ASR pairs, 419,731 machine translation text pairs, 1,530 TTS pairs, and 240 hours each of synthetic speech data for speech-to-unit and unit-to-speech tasks.
contributions.id: Makalah ini menyajikan korpus wicara paralel pertama antara bahasa Dzongkha dan Inggris serta *pipeline* kurasi berskala menggunakan model *text-to-speech* yang berbeda. Kontribusi utamanya mencakup 7.385 pasangan *ASR*, 419.731 pasangan teks *machine translation*, 1.530 pasangan *TTS*, serta masing-masing 240 jam data wicara sintetis untuk tugas *speech-to-unit* dan *unit-to-speech*.

future_work.en: Future work will focus on training and evaluating speech-to-speech translation models using metrics like BLEU, METEOR, character error rate, and mean opinion score, with a strong emphasis on tone and prosody. Additional directions include dialectal extension, transfer learning from close languages like Tibetan, real-time model optimization, and local community engagement in participatory data collection.
future_work.id: Peneletian lanjutan akan berfokus pada pelatihan dan evaluasi model *speech-to-speech translation* menggunakan metrik seperti *BLEU*, *METEOR*, *character error rate*, dan *mean opinion score*, dengan penekanan kuat pada nada dan prosodi. Arah tambahan mencakup perluasan dialek, *transfer learning* dari bahasa dekat seperti bahasa Tibet, optimasi model waktu nyata, dan pelibatan komunitas lokal dalam pengumpulan data partisipatif.

method.en: The methodology involves synthesizing aligned speech from translated text pairs using Google's gTTS for English and a tonally adjusted Tacotron2 system trained on native data for Dzongkha. The audio preprocessing pipeline applies spectral gating noise reduction, silence truncation, EBU R128 loudness normalization, and a PESQ threshold of 0.85, followed by tool-assisted temporal alignment and human verification.
method.id: Metodologi ini melibatkan sintesis wicara selaras dari pasangan teks terjemahan menggunakan *gTTS* milik Google untuk bahasa Inggris serta sistem *Tacotron2* yang disesuaikan nadanya dan dilatih pada data asli untuk bahasa Dzongkha. *Pipeline* prapemrosesan audio menerapkan pengurangan derau *spectral gating*, pemotongan keheningan, normalisasi kenyaringan *EBU R128*, dan ambang batas *PESQ* sebesar 0,85, yang diikuti oleh *temporal alignment* berbantuan alat dan verifikasi manusia.

related_work.en: Prior research in speech translation has long been dominated by cascaded systems involving automatic speech recognition, machine translation, and text-to-speech modules. However, these systems suffer from severe error propagation in low-resource settings, while direct end-to-end models like Translatotron avoid this but remain heavily dependent on large-scale parallel speech corpora.
related_work.id: Penelitian terdahulu dalam terjemahan wicara telah lama didominasi oleh sistem *cascaded* yang melibatkan modul *automatic speech recognition*, *machine translation*, dan *text-to-speech*. Kendati demikian, sistem-sistem ini menderita propagasi galat yang parah pada pengaturan *low-resource*, sementara model *end-to-end* langsung seperti Translatotron menghindari hal tersebut namun tetap sangat bergantung pada korpus wicara paralel skala besar.

results.en: The final dataset comprises multiple task-specific subsets, including 7,385 ASR pairs, 419,731 machine translation pairs, 1,530 TTS pairs, and 240 hours each of synthetic data for S2U and vocoder tasks. Visual inspection of 500 randomly selected sentence pairs demonstrated a 94 percent alignment accuracy within a plus or minus 0.2-second tolerance.
results.id: Dataset akhir terdiri dari berbagai subset khusus tugas, termasuk 7.385 pasangan *ASR*, 419.731 pasangan *machine translation*, 1.530 pasangan *TTS*, serta masing-masing 240 jam data sintetis untuk tugas *S2U* dan *vocoder*. Pemeriksaan visual terhadap 500 pasangan kalimat yang dipilih secara acak menunjukkan akurasi *alignment* sebesar 94 persen dalam toleransi plus minus 0,2 detik.

tldr.en: This paper introduces a novel method for curating the first Dzongkha-English speech parallel corpus using divergent TTS models. The resulting dataset successfully enables both cascaded and direct speech-to-speech translation development for low-resource languages.
tldr.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan metode baru untuk mengkurasi korpus paralel *speech-to-speech* pertama antara bahasa Dzongkha dan Inggris menggunakan model *TTS* yang berbeda. Dataset yang dihasilkan berhasil memfasilitasi pengembangan *speech-to-speech translation* berbasis *cascaded* maupun *direct* untuk bahasa *low-resource*.

doi:10.17586/2226-1494-2026-26-4-826-834.abstract: This paper focuses on the development of an automatic speech recognition system for the Livvi-Karelian variety of the Karelian language, as it is spoken under conditions of code-switching between Karelian and Russian. The study of bilingual speech recognition methods is carried out. In order to improve the quality of speech recognition, a methodology for training text data augmentation via partial translation and intra-word code-switched wordforms artificial synthesis was developed. Acoustic modeling was performed by fine-tuning a pre-trained multilingual Wav2Vec2-BERT 2.0 model with the use of the data from two previously collected corpora containing 7.5 hours of speech. Fine-tuning was performed using the Transformers framework. When developing the language model, in order to address the problem of limited code-switching data, an augmentation method was applied based on partial automatic translation of Karelian texts into Russian, followed by the generation of word-forms with intra-word code-switching based on special linguistic rules. On the base of formulated rules, a list of words with intra-word code-switching was generated for a language model. The experiments showed that using a full vocabulary that includes generated hybrid word forms yields a consistent improvement in results. A further reduction in word error rate to 25.82 % on the development set and 29 % on the test portion of the corpus was achieved through linear interpolation of the Karelian language model with the Russian language model (interpolation weight 0.7). The conducted experiments confirm the effectiveness of the developed methodology for developing a bilingual speech recognition system. In particular, it is recommended to combine finetuning of multilingual acoustic models, text augmentation with morphological rules, and language model interpolation. The proposed approach can be applied to developing speech recognition systems for other low-resource languages of Russia spoken in an unbalanced bilingual environment.

background.en: The paper focuses on developing an automatic speech recognition system for the Livvi-Karelian variety of the Karelian language under conditions of code-switching between Karelian and Russian. This addresses the challenge of building speech recognition systems for low-resource languages spoken in an unbalanced bilingual environment.
background.id: Makalah ini berfokus pada pengembangan sistem *automatic speech recognition* untuk ragam Livvi-Karelian dari bahasa Karelian di bawah kondisi *code-switching* antara bahasa Karelian dan Rusia. Hal ini mengatasi tantangan dalam membangun sistem pengenalan ucapan untuk *low-resource language* yang dituturkan dalam lingkungan dwibahasa yang tidak seimbang.

contributions.en: The study develops a methodology for training text data augmentation via partial translation and the artificial synthesis of intra-word code-switched wordforms. It also demonstrates the effectiveness of combining multilingual acoustic model fine-tuning, morphological text augmentation, and language model interpolation.
contributions.id: Studi ini mengembangkan metodologi untuk *text data augmentation* melalui terjemahan parsial dan sintesis buatan bentuk kata *intra-word* *code-switching*. Penelitian ini juga mendemonstrasikan efektivitas penggabungan *fine-tuning* *multilingual* *acoustic model*, *text augmentation* morfologis, dan interpolasi *language model*.

future_work.en: The authors suggest that the proposed approach can be applied to developing speech recognition systems for other low-resource languages of Russia spoken in an unbalanced bilingual environment.
future_work.id: Penulis menyarankan bahwa pendekatan yang diusulkan dapat diterapkan untuk mengembangkan sistem *speech recognition* untuk *low-resource language* lain di Rusia yang dituturkan dalam lingkungan dwibahasa yang tidak seimbang.

method.en: Acoustic modeling is performed by fine-tuning a pre-trained multilingual Wav2Vec2-BERT 2.0 model using the Transformers framework and data from two previously collected corpora containing 7.5 hours of speech. To address limited code-switching data, an augmentation method is applied using partial automatic translation of Karelian texts into Russian, followed by generating word-forms with intra-word code-switching based on special linguistic rules. Additionally, linear interpolation of the Karelian language model with the Russian language model is conducted using an interpolation weight of 0.7.
method.id: *Acoustic modeling* dilakukan dengan melakukan *fine-tuning* model *multilingual* *Wav2Vec2-BERT 2.0* *pre-trained* menggunakan *framework* *Transformers* dan data dari dua korpus yang dikumpulkan sebelumnya yang berisi 7.5 jam ucapan. Untuk mengatasi keterbatasan data *code-switching*, metode *augmentation* diterapkan menggunakan terjemahan otomatis parsial dari teks Karelian ke bahasa Rusia, diikuti dengan pembuatan bentuk kata dengan *intra-word* *code-switching* berdasarkan aturan linguistik khusus. Selain itu, interpolasi linear dari *language model* Karelian dengan *language model* Rusia dilakukan menggunakan bobot interpolasi 0.7.

related_work.en: The paper does not discuss related work in detail.
related_work.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas penelitian terkait secara mendetail.

results.en: Using a full vocabulary that includes generated hybrid word forms yields a consistent improvement in results. A further reduction in word error rate to 25.82 percent on the development set and 29 percent on the test portion of the corpus was achieved through linear interpolation of the Karelian language model with the Russian language model.
results.id: Penggunaan *vocabulary* penuh yang mencakup bentuk kata hibrida yang dihasilkan memberikan peningkatan hasil yang konsisten. Penurunan lebih lanjut pada *word error rate* menjadi 25.82 persen pada *development set* dan 29 persen pada bagian *test* dari korpus dicapai melalui interpolasi linear *language model* Karelian dengan *language model* Rusia.

tldr.en: This paper develops an automatic speech recognition system for Livvi-Karelian under Karelian-Russian code-switching conditions. It finds that combining multilingual acoustic model fine-tuning, morphological text augmentation, and language model interpolation successfully reduces the word error rate.
tldr.id: Makalah ini mengembangkan *automatic speech recognition* untuk Livvi-Karelian dalam kondisi *code-switching* Karelian-Rusia. Penelitian ini menemukan bahwa kombinasi *fine-tuning* *multilingual* *acoustic model*, *text augmentation* morfologis, dan interpolasi *language model* berhasil menurunkan *word error rate*.

doi:10.17977/um065.v7.i1.2027.10.abstract: Digital competence frameworks for teachers have proliferated, but whether their critical, reflective dimension has been examined among technical and vocational education and training (TVET) instructors remains uncharacterized. This scoping review characterized the methodological approaches, conceptual operationalizations, and evidence gaps in peer-reviewed research on critical digital literacy (CDL) among TVET instructors. Following Joanna Briggs Institute guidance and reported per PRISMA-ScR, Scopus was searched on 3 July 2026 using a Population-Concept-Context strategy, restricted to English-language, peer-reviewed literature from 2013–2026. Eligible sources were charted against a framework combining bibliographic, PCC, and methodological data items. Eighty sources met the eligibility criteria. Results included sources concentrated in Western, Northern, and Southern Europe (30.0%) and Southeast Asia (27.5%, including Indonesia at 22.5%), with smaller shares from East Asia, Eastern Europe/Central Asia, and other regions. Quantitative survey designs accounted for roughly half of charted approaches, while qualitative, configurational, and computational designs were comparatively rare. Nine concept-operationalization categories emerged, with an explicit critical-reflective or ethical dimension reported in only 11.2% of sources. An evidence gap map identified 22 of 54 (40.7%) concept-by-context combinations with no charted source, most notably critical-reflective framing paired with Southeast Asian settings. Research on CDL among TVET instructors relies heavily on a single methodological mode and has not yet reconciled structured competence frameworks with the construct’s critical-reflective dimension, particularly outside Europe. Priority directions include region-specific research on critical-reflective CDL in Southeast Asia, a dedicated CDL-specific instrument, and continued tracking of the emerging artificial-intelligence-related sub-theme.

doi:10.17977/um065.v7.i3.2027.2.abstract: The presence and rapid development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has expanded its potential use in education and generated pedagogical and ethical challenges in education all at once, particularly in locality-based learning. Despite continuous development of studies on AI in education, the studies exploring how teacher utilizes AI to develop teaching material maintaining local language and culture characteristics are still limited. This research is intended to explore Javanese language teachers’ perspective on their strategies, challenges, and practices in utilizing AI to design instructional materials. Using qualitative method supporting with in-depth interview with seven Javanese language teachers experienced in using AI in instructional material design. Data analysis revealed three main findings. First, teachers utilized AI as a means of identifying students’ needs and materials, enhancing content, and drafting early instructional material. Second, AI implementation was still faced with various challenges, encompassing teachers’ limited digital competency, the need for time to carry out validation, AI’s limitation in representing linguistic and cultural characteristics of Javanese language contextually, and indecision over the validity of information source produced. Third, teachers formulated various adaptive strategies by positioning AI as supporting partner rather than as pedagogic decision maker, improves professional competency in AI use, and carries out critical evaluation, verification, and triangulation on all AI outputs before being implemented in the learning process. This finding expands literature on the integration of AI in education by demonstrating that AI potentially support locality-based instructional material design; moreover it is compensated with strong pedagogical supervision and teachers’ adequate professional competency. This research implication corroborates the importance of strengthening teachers’ AI literacy and developing AI system that is more sensitive to local language and cultural context to support more contextual, inclusive, and meaningful learning.

doi:10.18255/1818-1015-2026-3-420-440.abstract: The paper addresses the task of automatic topic classification of texts in the Tatar language, a low-resource language with rich agglutinative morphology. In the era of rapid development of large language models (LLMs), one of the key methodological challenges is the creation of open corpora, tokenizers, and annotated datasets, which are essential for both effective fine-tuning of modern neural architectures and objective evaluation of their performance. The development of such resources and the establishment of reproducible benchmarks remain an important scientific objective regardless of evolving technological paradigms. This study aims to develop an open resource base for Tatar natural language processing and to validate it experimentally in the task of topic classification. The paper presents and evaluates a set of newly developed resources, including the TatCorp 222M corpus (222 million tokens), the TatarTokenizers toolkit, the Tatar2Vec pre-trained embedding models (FastText, Word2Vec, and CBOW), and a manually annotated dataset containing 13,160 texts from ten thematic categories. The embedding models were trained on the TatCorp 222M corpus and selected from 57 configurations using a proposed composite evaluation metric. A systematic comparison of five text representation methods, including the Tatar2Vec embeddings, TF-IDF, and Bag of Words, combined with seven classification algorithms ranging from linear models and ensemble methods to multilayer perceptrons, was conducted. In addition, the influence of BPE-based subword tokenization on topic classification performance was investigated. The highest Macro $F_1$-score (0.7789) was achieved by combining pre-trained Word2Vec embeddings (without subword tokenization) with a multilayer perceptron (MLP), while a comparable Macro $F_1$-score (0.7760) and the highest ROC AUC (0.9683) were obtained using Bag of Words with XGBoost. The experiments demonstrate that BPE subword tokenization does not improve, but consistently degrades, topic classification performance for an agglutinative language (Macro $F_1$ is reduced by the amount up to 0.0234). The developed open resources and reproducible benchmarks provide a foundation for future comparative studies, including the evaluation of transformer-based models for Tatar and other low-resource Turkic languages.
